title: Minimum Swaps To Group All 1s Together II
statement:
Treat `nums` as circular, so its first and last positions are adjacent. In one swap, exchange values at two distinct positions. Return the minimum number of swaps needed to make all existing `1`s occupy consecutive circular positions.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0]
Output: 1
```

```text
Input: nums = [0, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0]
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: nums = [1, 1, 0, 0, 1]
Output: 0
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 10^5`
- `nums[i]` is `0` or `1`.
